$comment: Public edits of the app changelog (scripts/sync-changelog.mjs). Keyed by entry id; sourceHash is the hash of the source entry the edit was written against, printed by the sync. Each edit replaces only the fields it sets (title, dateISO, kind, blocks) or hides the entry (hide: true); why says which site rule it applies.

blocks.text: In French, amounts, file sizes and video lengths now read the French way, with a space between thousands and a decimal comma (20 000, 2,5), in the studios, the editors, Shorts autopilot and the balance pages.

2026-09-29-tiktok-a-real-tiktok-preview-.why: TikTok carries the Beta tag again (help center, account-and-sign-in; positioning: always label TikTok Beta), so the out-of-Beta sentence is dropped.

blocks.text: The publishing step now shows your post the way TikTok does, the clip full screen with the caption over it, and the clip plays right there: tap to play, tap to pause, and drag along the bar to any moment. The caption box is clearer: a titled box, a field for your brief and the button under it. Captions written with AI follow TikTok's current rules, researched this month: the hook and the words people search for up front, 3 to 5 specific hashtags, an open question to close, no link, no asking for likes. A new AI-generated content choice labels a clip made with AI, ticked for you when hubStudio rendered it. Clips picked from the Assets Library now show their first frame.

2026-09-28-help-center-published-online.why: No credits: the help article is Balance and payments.

blocks.text: The hubStudio help center is now published at hubstudio.ai/help with step by step articles covering Explore, the Image and Video studios, History, Skills, Team, Clients, the balance and payments, your account and more. The guides include real app screenshots to help you find features and settings quickly.

2026-09-27-clients-and-their-client-spac.why: No credits (positioning: client logins hold no balance).

blocks.text: An admin adds the companies the team works for under Clients on the Team page and gives their people a login. A client login opens on its Client space and sees only the work made for its company: it downloads it, comments on it and approves it. Client logins hold no balance.

2026-09-27-four-roles-admin-creator-view.why: No credits: the team pays from its balance.

blocks.text: Creators make the images, videos and posts from the team's balance. Viewers see the team's work and spend nothing. Clients see only what was made for their company.

hubstudio-opens.why: The source entry has no date: 27 September 2026 is the day it was written (BearingBridge commit bb9b60d, the hubStudio launch). No credits and no amount (positioning, Money).

blocks.text: **Create images and videos with the best engines, from one prepaid balance.**

list: **Explore** every image and video engine in one gallery: who makes it, what it does (text to image, image editing, upscaling, text to video, image to video, video from references) and what one run costs. Search, filter by use or by maker, sort by price, and open any engine straight into its studio.
**Image studio**: render from a prompt, edit a picture you upload, or upscale and restore one. Every option each engine sells is in the form, with the price shown before you run.
**Video studio**: film a prompt, animate a still, or follow pictures and clips you attach, with the price per second shown before the render.
**History** keeps everything you and your team made, newest first: open it full size, download it, or send its prompt back to the studio for a variation.

**Skills** shape how "Improve with AI" rewrites your prompts: fourteen ready skills for images and video (packshots, lifestyle scenes, a consistent character, text inside an image, camera moves, vertical video ads and more), plus the social network formats. Add them to your own skills and make them yours.

**Work alone or as a team.** Sign up for yourself, create a team, or ask to join one. A team shares one balance; administrators invite people, answer requests to join and set a daily limit per member.
**A prepaid balance**, topped up by card, Alipay or WeChat Pay, with automatic top-up on a saved card and an invoice for every top-up.
